materials_exhausted.note: Bounded source recovery reopened XML/NXML, PDF text, OA package members, supplementary indexes/tables/text, packet database snapshots, and merged APD6 sequence/activity/literature rows. No supplementary assets exist locally for this paper. The primary source supports qualitative SA activity/immunity phenotype evidence but not APD6 broad spectrum, sequence, modification, or MOA annotations.

summary: Worker-2/4/6 re-review resolved the prior generic source-review failure for this paper. The source-supported final layer retains one qualitative M. luteus inhibition-zone activity record and verifies the APD6 literature citation, while preserving APD6 sequence, broad-spectrum activity, and MOA text as database-only relative to the 1976 primary source. Final status is accepted_with_cautions, not clean acceptance.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: APD6 AP01204 is citation-linked to this article, and the paper supports the SA name/context plus qualitative M. luteus indicator assay. APD6 sequence, modifications, broad target spectrum, temperature/protease robustness, and DNA/RNA/protein synthesis MOA text are not in the local 1976 paper and remain database_only_no_primary_source rather than source_verified.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: The prior missing-activity failure is repaired with one source-supported qualitative inhibition-zone presence row for M. luteus. The paper does not report MIC, MBC, hemolysis, cytotoxicity, or exact inhibition-zone diameters; no quantitative values are fabricated.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: The final mechanism layer is limited to indirect genetic-transfer/immunity context. It does not promote APD6 or cited-older-paper MOA text as a direct mechanism claim for this article.
per_layer_decision_rationale.worker_2_body_table_activity: PDF text and tables were inspected. Tables I/II are genetic transduction/stability tables, so only the prose-supported M. luteus inhibition-zone screen is curated as activity evidence.
per_layer_decision_rationale.worker_4_database_record_audit: Database-only APD6 claims are preserved explicitly; the literature citation row is source_verified only for DOI/PMID/PMCID traceability.
per_layer_decision_rationale.worker_6_final_adjudication: The original ticket is closed because source-reviewed owner-layer artifacts now separate supported facts from unsupported database annotations and strict gates can be rerun without open rework targets.

caution_findings.evidence_context: The primary paper supports M. luteus inhibition-zone phenotype testing of SA-positive transductants but no MIC/MBC/toxicity values or exact inhibition-zone measurements.
APD6 AP01204 contains sequence, broad target spectrum, production-condition, and MOA annotations not recovered from this local 1976 source; those fields remain database_only_no_primary_source.
The local OA package contains only NXML/PDF members and supplementary indexes are empty; no absent supplement is kept as an open rework blocker.
Direct antimicrobial MOA statements are not asserted from this paper; final mechanism evidence is indirect genetic determinant context only.
